Hi Morgan — great to talk. Attaching a proposal and a simple cost model (see attachments). High level here so Finance has what they need quickly:

Summary of tiered commit pricing (net, after standard PLG credits):
- 12-month commit: baseline unit $/GPU-hr = $6.40; estimated $/1M tokens = $325 (depending on model & quantization).
- 24-month commit: baseline unit $/GPU-hr = $5.40 (≈15% discount vs 12m); estimated $/1M tokens = $275.
- 36-month commit: baseline unit $/GPU-hr = $4.80 (≈25% discount vs 12m); estimated $/1M tokens = $240.

Startgate (phased start window):
- Standard offer: 60-day startgate from signature. During the window you pay for a deposit equal to 10% of committed monthly spend (applied as credit to the first full billing month once capacity is active).
- If you place resources into "holding" state (allocated but not activated) we charge a lower hold rate of 20% of the baseline unit $/GPU-hr until activation.

Throughput & burst policy:
- Baseline throughput guarantee: we guarantee a sustained baseline tokens/sec per GPU pool tailored to your profile (we'll size after a short performance run).
- Bursts: you get a 30% burst buffer above baseline with auto-burst fees at discounted rate; larger burst requirements can be covered by a purchased burst credit bucket (one-time top-up).

Delays and credits:
- If activation is delayed beyond the startgate for reasons covered in Section 5 (force majeure, provider-side infra delays), Redwood will provide pro-rated credits equal to the deposit or the hold charges paid, whichever is greater.

Next steps: I attached ELR-proposal-v1.pdf and a cost model. If that looks close, I can get legal and ops to lay in the exact SLO wording and a DocuSign link.
